cv=$(cargo --version); rv=$(rustc --version); cc=$(cargo clippy --version)
case $cv in "cargo 1.98.1 "*) ;; *) echo "PIN FAIL cargo: $cv"; exit 1;; esac
case $rv in "rustc 1.98.1 "*) ;; *) echo "PIN FAIL rustc: $rv"; exit 1;; esac
case $cc in "clippy 0.1.98 "*) ;; *) echo "PIN FAIL clippy: $cc"; exit 1;; esac
echo "PIN OK: $cv | $rv | $cc"

GW="${PACKET_WORKTREE:?export PACKET_WORKTREE=this ticket worktree}"
TOM=d5e06fd03f6bedf7827bd6ce2e3f47b1f5ce1972ecfdec8e8301046555e469d4
LOK=141ae6c07c7de738619e584de7ee1f96f9fc147a05864c15313a33e474574cfb
for R in 6214a58bc747007129d820431375255625ec9396 f773b2de6e088f7a41826451a1f1cc506e141ffb df5e3d9fd6328b856c7eb55499c54c8a55a78d3f; do
  GT=$(git -C "$GW" cat-file blob "$R:Cargo.toml" | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1)
  GL=$(git -C "$GW" cat-file blob "$R:Cargo.lock" | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1)
  [ "$GT" = "$TOM" ] || { echo "CARGO.TOML AT $R MISMATCH sha256=$GT"; exit 1; }
  [ "$GL" = "$LOK" ] || { echo "CARGO.LOCK AT $R MISMATCH sha256=$GL"; exit 1; }
done
pk=$(git -C "$GW" cat-file blob df5e3d9fd6328b856c7eb55499c54c8a55a78d3f:Cargo.lock | grep -c "^\[\[package\]\]")
[ "$pk" = 428 ] || { echo "PACKAGE COUNT $pk != 428"; exit 1; }
echo "MANIFEST OK: toml+lock sha256 equal to frozen base fingerprints at BASE, re-anchored base, and V; 428 packages; no new crates"

EV=/tmp/d34_gate_df5e3d9
bn=$(grep -c "^### FILTER " "$EV/batteries.all.log"); fx=$(grep -c "^FILTER_EXIT=0$" "$EV/batteries.all.log")
ok=$(grep -cE "^test result: ok\. [1-9][0-9]* passed" "$EV/batteries.all.log")
nb=$(grep "^test result:" "$EV/batteries.all.log" | grep -cv "^test result: ok\. " || true)
[ "$bn" = 7 ] && [ "$fx" = 7 ] && [ "$ok" = 7 ] && [ "${nb:-0}" = 0 ] || { echo "CANONICAL b=$bn exit0=$fx ok=$ok nonok=$nb"; exit 1; }
ord=$(sed -n 's/^### FILTER \(.*\) (invocation.*)$/\1/p' "$EV/batteries.all.log" | tr "\n" "|")
wn="persistence::persona|app::dialogs|core::prompt|core::turn|hostile_persona|persona_boundary|fatal_classes|"
[ "$ord" = "$wn" ] || { echo "CANONICAL ORDER $ord"; exit 1; }
lb=$(grep -c "^### FILTER " "$EV/att9/live_batteries.log"); lf=$(grep -c "^FILTER_EXIT=0$" "$EV/att9/live_batteries.log")
lo=$(grep -cE "^test result: ok\. [1-9][0-9]* passed" "$EV/att9/live_batteries.log")
[ "$lb" = 7 ] && [ "$lf" = 7 ] && [ "$lo" = 7 ] || { echo "LIVE b=$lb exit0=$lf ok=$lo"; exit 1; }
echo "BATTERIES OK: canonical 7/7 present+green+ordered; live this-epoch rerun at V 7/7 green (9/21/13/19/5/2/1)"
